origin.description: Tools for computing on license specifications.
origin.details: Packages record licenses in DESCRIPTION using standardized components, version restrictions, and file pointers. This checks whether a string is canonical or standardizable, expands version ranges, and reports FOSS verification when the license database allows it.
origin.value: A list with is_canonical, is_standardizable, standardization, components, expansions, is_verified, is_FOSS, restricts_use, and related fields.
origin.example:
analyze_license("GPL-2")
analyze_license("LGPL (>= 2.0, < 3) | Mozilla Public License")
analyze_license("GPL-2 | file LICENCE")
analyze_license("GPL (>= 2) | BSD_3_clause + file LICENSE")
analyze_license("Artistic-2.0 | AGPL-3 + file LICENSE")
